data.text:
Baljeet Singh And Another vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 23 
July, 2024 
Author: Manoj Kumar Gupta
Bench: Manoj Kumar Gupta
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:119357-Db
Court No. - 21
Case :- Writ - C No. - 21285 of 2024
Petitioner :- Baljeet Singh And Another
Respondent :- State Of Up And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Santosh Kumar Singh 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar Nigam,J.
1.  Petitioners have prayed for quashing of the recovery citation dated 3.4.2024 as well as order dated 30.1.2024 passed by respondent No.4 under the provisions of Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006.
2. It is not disputed that against the said order, appeal lies before the Appellate Tribunal as contemplated u/s 70 of the Act. However, learned counsel for the petitioners contended before this Court on the last date that Tribunal has not been established so far and therefore, the petitioners have no other alternative remedy except to approach this Court. 
Baljeet Singh And Another vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 23 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155955018/
1 3. Consequently, we have called for the instructions from the State - respondents. In compliance thereof, instructions have been furnished, according to which, Appellate Tribunal was constituted by notification dated 14.6.2013. The Appellate Tribunal for Azamgarh Mandal is in Varanasi. Ballia falls under Azamgarh Region, therefore, petitioner can approach the Tribunal. 
4. In view of the same, we decline to examine the challenge and relegate the petitioner to the alternative remedy provided under the Act. 
5. The instant petition stands disposed of accordingly. 
6. All pleas and contentions are left open for being raised before the Tribunal. 
Order Date :- 23.7.2024 Rishabh [Manish Kumar Nigam, J.] [Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.]
